==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number", "story name" and "formatted name" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>InQuestCite|''ISSUE NUMBER''|''STORY NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}

Ignore the big red error above; the error will not appear when the template is transcluded provided that valid input is given for the first parameter.
